title: Checkmate by the Window
description: A surreal dark fantasy scene shows a multi-armed skeletal demon with a golden crown and rings seated atop a massive pile of coins and rings. In the foreground, a chessboard with scattered fallen silver pieces and lit candles sits beside a woman in a pink dress reclining on a blue chaise lounge, gazing toward an arched stone window revealing a frozen landscape at sunset with a distant castle.
